About

Academic background

I'm Seungho Jung. My master’s research at Sungkyunkwan University’s ECE department and Media System Laboratory (MSL) focuses on generative models, computer vision, and medical image analysis.

With 3 published papers, 2 accepted papers and 1 paper in progress, my work spans medical vision models and representation learning. My background in software development supports the implementation of research ideas.
